beats.text: Why do GPUs sit idle during LLM inference until The Bradley-Terry Reward Engine unlocks 85% throughput?
beats.visual_focus: A cloud of disparate point-data representing human feedback rankings collapsing into a structured manifold.

visual_blueprint.title: PREFERENCE MANIFOLD COLLAPSE
visual_blueprint.sub: Mapping subjective human feedback into a continuous scalar field

motif_params.title: PREFERENCE MANIFOLD COLLAPSE
motif_params.sub: Mapping subjective human feedback into a continuous scalar field

beats.text: The bottleneck is fitting this mess into a scalar value while our model treats the prompt-response pair like a blind black-box.
beats.visual_focus: A bottleneck funnel where diverse text tokens squeeze into a narrow scalar output gate.

visual_blueprint.title: REWARD FUNNELING
visual_blueprint.sub: Condensing high-dimensional semantics into a single preference probability

motif_params.title: REWARD FUNNELING
motif_params.sub: Condensing high-dimensional semantics into a single preference probability

beats.text: We solve this using a Bradley-Terry model to transform the raw, chaotic rank-labels into a differentiable sigmoid loss function.
beats.visual_focus: A sigmoid function graph anchoring human relative rankings to probabilistic outputs.
